entities.name: Ariarathes VI of Cappadocia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ariarathes VI Epiphanes Philopator, was the Ariarathid king of Cappadocia from 130 BC to 116 BC. He was the youngest son of Ariarathes V of Cappadocia and Nysa of Cappadocia.
